changes: Land Clearing pricing: admin-editable settings (base price, acreage threshold, per-acre rate, markup) seeded from Alex Porter's/Palmetto Land Solutions real quote ($750 flat under 0.5 acres, $1,500/acre at or above), a GET estimate endpoint that pulls acreage from Smart Data when not passed explicitly, an acreage price-helper block inside the Change Order modal, and a settings card at the top of the Vendor Directory admin panel.

Smart Data: new property_smart_data table + GET/POST endpoints for property characteristics (heated/cooled sqft, lot size, year built, beds/baths) with source tracking (county_record / sales_package / manual) and a hasMinimumRequired flag (heated sqft + lot size). New reusable SmartDataPanel component wired into the Repair Consult intake step; a 'From Smart Data' auto-fill button added to the Inspections+ subject-sqft field. Kept push-based per Alex's decision (no paid property-data API integration) — manual entry is the fallback when no data is on file.
Epoxy Flooring added as a flooring installation catalog item (flooring_epoxy trade, flat unit).
